 10 Winona Ryder Movies Every ‘90s Kid Is Due for a Rewatch On 
 ‘Beetlejuice’ and ‘Heathers’ made her famous, but the decade that came next is the one worth a second look. By Matt Hoffman | Oct 29, 2026, 8:00 PM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Ethan Hawke And Winona Ryder in 'Reality Bites' | Universal Pictures/GettyImages Back in the 1990s , Winona Ryder went from goth teen to two-time Oscar nominee, picking up nominations in back-to-back years for The Age of Innocence and Little Women . She also played a Puritan, an android, and a vampire’s bride, and starred in the movie that sent Lisa Loeb to No. 1. 
--> Back in the 1990s , Winona Ryder went from goth teen to two-time Oscar nominee, picking up nominations in back-to-back years for The Age of Innocence and Little Women . She also played a Puritan, an android, and a vampire’s bride, and starred in the movie that sent Lisa Loeb to No. 1. 
 Here are 10 of her movies from the decade, in the order they came out, with a reason to queue each one up again. (Rotten Tomatoes scores are as of October 2026.)

--> The Age of Innocence (1993)
 The Age of Innocence adapts Edith Wharton ’s 1920 novel about a New York society lawyer in the 1870s (Daniel Day-Lewis) who falls for his fiancée’s cousin (Michelle Pfeiffer), the book that made Wharton the first woman to win the Pulitzer Prize for a novel.
